title: Policy Enforcement
content:
- ### Definition
  - Mechanisms and procedures implementing security and governance policies within narrative systems. Ensures compliance with defined rules through access controls, audit logging, and decision points that validate actions against policy constraints.

- ### Semantic Classification
  - owl-class:: infrastructure:PolicyEnforcement
  - owl-role:: Object
  - belongs-to-domain:: [[Narrative Gold Mine]]

- ### Relationships
  - is-subclass-of:: [[GovernanceMechanism]]
  - has-part:: [[Access Control Engine]], [[Policy Evaluator]], [[Audit Logger]], [[Decision Point]], [[Remediation Handler]]
  - enables:: [[Compliance Assurance]], [[Governance]], [[Auditability]], [[Regulatory Adherence]]
  - bridges-to:: [[Trust Framework]], [[Trust Infrastructure]] (domain: ngm)
  - depends-on:: [[Trust Infrastructure]], [[Data Layer]]

- ### Content
  Policy Enforcement ensures that security and governance rules are consistently applied throughout narrative systems. By evaluating decisions at critical system points against defined policies, it prevents unauthorised actions and maintains compliance. Comprehensive audit logging provides evidence of compliance and enables incident investigation.
